description: This file defines enums, classes, and inline functions related to shader data types, qualifiers, and layout qualifiers used in the ANGLE graphics project. It includes type definitions for precision, basic types, qualifiers, image formats, and shader layout qualifiers, as well as utility functions for string representations and type checks.

classes.name: TBasicMangledName
classes.description: A class for generating mangled names for basic shader types based on their enum value.
